name: list_devices
description: Use this when the user wants to see paired Nymrel Remote devices and current reachability before working with one.

name: read_file
description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to read a UTF-8 text file with optional line pagination. Select the target with the optional device argument.

device.description: Paired device id or exact device name. Omit only when exactly one eligible device is available.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the configured working directory.

offset.description: 0-based start line; negative values read from the tail.

name: list_directory
description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to list a directory tree with a bounded recursion depth. Select the target with the optional device argument.

device.description: Paired device id or exact device name. Omit only when exactly one eligible device is available.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the configured working directory.

name: get_file_info
description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to return metadata for a file or directory. Select the target with the optional device argument.

device.description: Paired device id or exact device name. Omit only when exactly one eligible device is available.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the configured working directory.

name: search_files
description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to search file and directory names below an allowed path. Select the target with the optional device argument.

device.description: Paired device id or exact device name. Omit only when exactly one eligible device is available.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the configured working directory.

name: search_content
description: Use this when the user explicitly wants Nymrel Remote to search UTF-8 file contents below an allowed path. Select the target with the optional device argument.

device.description: Paired device id or exact device name. Omit only when exactly one eligible device is available.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the configured working directory.

name: get_read_result
description: Retrieve the result of your pending Nymrel Remote read using its callId. If a file inspection returns pending, use this tool instead of submitting that inspection again. It never starts a new device operation. If still pending, wait briefly before checking again.
